text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(That footwork— 
not something honed through training for 
racing.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(A strong core, and not a wasted movement. 
Judging by her gait, she has training in 
the art of iai.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how that one runs... 
I should like to face her in a match.
